caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile piece with a vertical extension at the bottom center, giving it a tunic-like shape. The textile is rendered in fine pencil lines on a light, off-white background. The main body contains elaborate decorative patterns: the central area features an ornate square panel with a basket of flowers and surrounding floral motifs, including intricate lattices and geometric borders. The areas flanking the center are filled with symmetrical, repeating stylized floral arrangements, possibly sheaves or fans, interspersed with leafy vines. At the top of the textile are two circular floral motifs, one on each side, with cursive text between them reading "Ames Church 1819." The overall composition is highly detailed, emphasizing the texture and ornamental embroidery of the fabric. The color of the composition is monochromatic, limited to the pencil’s gray tones against the ivory background. In the lower right corner, there is a small, cursive signature.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
